App-opener funnel; the experiment uses fixed scheduled workdays.

Our largest account is evaluating a leaner rival. Compliance combines the longest workflow gap with coordinator CSAT of 2.2 / 5.

The proposed value

Reuse route details and make each compliance answer explicit in one checklist. Preserve the records managers rely on.

The hypothesis

Removing verified recording friction improves completed daily logs by at least 12 points versus control, without weakening record quality.

Sources: Problem hook · Hypothesis and scenario metrics. Figures are supplied scenario evidence; the proposed lift is untested.

One checklist, a deliberately narrow scope

Must-have workflow

One tap from the route. Six reused fields. Twelve blank checks require explicit answers. Every Fail needs a reason.

Protect the pilot

Cut auto-fill, dashboard rebuilds and AI ETAs. Handle late alerts as a separate reliability issue.

VEL-01: a fixed test with live safety checks

14 daysCurrent flow vs B1 · 1:1 by coordinator within account

Compare completed daily obligations over scheduled workdays fixed before assignment. Non-use counts as zero. Analyze coordinators, with account weights fixed before exposure.

Scenario planning: 48% → 60% (+12 points). Re-estimate the roster baseline and power before build. The assumed 540 eligible coordinators are unconfirmed.

Read efficacy on day 14. Monitor safety daily. Invalid measurement or unfinished audits block a ship decision.

DecisionRequired evidence
ShipΔ ≥ 12 points, p < .05 and 95% CI above zero. Audited quality passes; ≥ 2 of 3 account effects positive; week-2 lift ≥ half of week 1.
PauseAccuracy deterioration > 2 points, unresolved quality concerns or a clearly harmed account. A Fail rate below half of control triggers an audit. Confirmed severe harm stops the variant immediately.
KillFor a valid, safe test: the primary 95% CI is wholly at or below zero.
IterateHold rollout for other valid results, including uncertainty, a smaller lift or failed persistence.

Source: VEL-01 full protocol, ordered rules and safety actions. Planning thresholds require agreement before exposure.

Three accounts, with a gate before each stage

Before build

Observe the job. Confirm the 12-check fit, eligible enrollment, baseline, power and feasible measurement plan.

Weeks 1–2

Build B1. Verify telemetry, write guards and usability, then run a two-day canary before randomization.

Weeks 3–4

Run the full 14-day test. Gate failures move the dates. PM, compliance owner and engineering monitor safety.

Engagement goal · M targeted launch

For eligible coordinators: a CS demo and in-app entry from the route. Managers receive a quality recap. Mismatched checklists stay out.

Opened but unfinished logs: investigate friction and hold the next wave. Expand only after a ship decision and seven-day operations review.

WatchHow it informs the decision
CompletionEffect versus control; sustained target locked before exposure.
QualityMatched audits, corrections and Fail-rate checks.
Time / CSATUsability and trust diagnostics.

Source: GTM and dashboard. Four weeks is the proposed plan after the pre-build gate, not a guaranteed launch date. The pilot has not run.

What changed my product judgment

Follow the workflow

I began with the driver's three-tap delivery problem. Coordinator timing and CSAT moved the first bet to compliance. The earlier journey keeps that reasoning visible.

Check the mechanism

Dispatch quotes do not establish compliance friction. I need to observe whether recording work or the required physical checks cause the delay.

Make the result decidable

An absolute 60% target cannot establish lift. I now use concurrent control, fixed workday denominators and safety rules. A proposed median also cannot establish savings from a mean baseline.

Source: Individual insights.

Approve discovery, then a gated B1 pilot

First confirm the workflow, checklist fit and feasible sample. If the evidence gate passes, release the proposed four-week pilot capacity at three eligible accounts.

2 engineers · 1 designer · 1 CS lead
PM ownership and compliance review throughout

The return

A completion effect with uncertainty, audited record quality and a clear ship, iterate or kill decision.
